name: veterinary_clinic_system_092_idempotent_occupancy_sync
instruction: Sync the boarding occupancy board against the reservation book as of the episode date, idempotently. A run is 'occupied' with current_patient_id set to a reservation's patient only when there is exactly one active checked_in reservation for that run; a reservation is active when status='checked_in' AND check_in <= episode_date < check_out. Otherwise the run must be 'available' with current_patient_id empty. Update only the runs whose status or current_patient_id actually need to change, and set synced='<batch_code>' only on those changed runs. After the sync, append exactly one audit_log row {action: 'BOARDING_RUNS_SYNCED', actor: 'system', actor_role: 'system', target_collection: 'boarding_runs', target_id: 'sync-<batch_code>', details: 'Synced <N> runs to reservation book as of <episode date>.', occurred_at: episode timestamp}. A second run with the same batch code must change no runs and must not append a second audit log row.
_max_steps_note: set after live gold measurement in QC session
_par_steps_note: set after live gold measurement in QC session

success_criteria.summary: Each of the 17 runs matches the active reservation set as of the episode date; only runs that differ from seed have synced=batch; unchanged runs have no synced field; exactly one audit_log sync record; active reservation set computed two independent ways (API filter and SQL range query) and must agree.

checks.expect: Run status and occupant derived from active checked_in reservations; synced only on changed runs; one audit_log row; canary on all other collections.
active run set computed by API Python filter and SQL range query must agree

hazards: The 5 checked_in boarding_reservations (ids 1-5) have check_out dates 2026-09-06 and 2026-09-07, all before the episode-date jitter window (2026-09-27..2026-10-03). A solution that treats any checked_in reservation as active without checking check_in <= episode_date < check_out will leave runs 1-5 occupied and fail.

There are 43 'reserved' and 92 'checked_out' boarding_reservations with various dates and run_id values that overlap the boarding_runs. A solution must ignore reservations whose status is not checked_in or whose date range does not cover the episode.

All 17 boarding_runs are in the snapshot: runs 1-5 are 'occupied' with current_patient_id 2/4/6/8/10; runs 6-17 are 'available'. A solution that stamps synced=batch on every run (not just the ones whose state changes) will set synced on runs 6-17 and fail.

The expected final state has all runs available with empty current_patient_id. A solution that sets current_patient_id to null with a literal SQL NULL but leaves it as the string 'None' or as an uncast value will fail the string/None canary.
A solution that appends an audit log row on every run, or on every run even when no state changed, will create duplicate audit rows and fail.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Turns a simple occupancy flag sync into a date-windowed reconciliation between boarding_reservations and boarding_runs, with change-only synced tagging and a single audit_log record. The verifier cross-checks the active reservation set via API and SQL and enforces that only changed runs carry the synced watermark.
